referral.reason_text: Raised ALT and iron deficiency anaemia, Hb 10.4. Known fatty liver on ultrasound 2022.

deciding.fast_track_met: Iron deficiency anaemia (Hb 104, ferritin 9) at age 66 meets the criterion. The results are about 4 months old, which is a reason for doubt.
deciding.vetting_outcome: Iron deficiency anaemia at 66 is unexplained by the fatty liver, which accounts only for the ALT. That is enough for an earlier slot even with the older bloods.
deciding.first_contact: Abnormal LFTs together with anaemia at 66 need face-to-face consultant assessment. No procedure-ready record is shown.
deciding.clinical_urgency: The anaemia is unexplained, but the bloods date from January with no documented change since. Level 0 or level 1 are both reasonable.
deciding.record_agreement: Hb is written 10.4 in the text and 104 g/L in the results, which is only a unit-format difference. A reader may call this trivial (level 2) or treat all values as agreeing (level 3).
